text:
maya: Observed a repeatable oscillation during int4-v2 canary on /rerank. Opening thread to propose a rollout guard for feedback amplification.

kevin: What did we see?

maya: Variant share jumped 12% -> 38% then decayed to ~22% over 2h. RERANK_COARSE precision@10 down ~1.6% absolute, p99 latency +25ms on affected customers. Shadow diffs looked fine.

jess: Pattern looks like model output nudges users to requery or click differently, which changes request distribution. We've seen this on longtail cohorts.

eval-bot: shadow summary: concordance 0.987 overall, RERANK_COARSE KL=0.11, reorder_rate +5.8%. Link: https://grafana.internal/r/abc

kevin: Proposal: two_of_three signal autofallback. Signals = quality_drop (precision@10 <= -1%), entropy_shift (mean_entropy <= -0.25) OR KL>0.08, behavior_amp (reorder_rate >= +4%). Require 3 consecutive 5m windows.

jess: Add SE noise floor: effect must be >= 2*SE in window. Also special-case latency: if p99_delta > 30ms AND no quality_drop -> escalate to manual rollback. If p99_delta >30ms + quality_drop -> auto rollback.

maya: Baseline config: window=60m, decay=0.2. Autofallback YAML sketch:
```
auto_fallback:
 strategy: two_of_three
 windows: 5m
 consecutive: 3
 thresholds: {quality: -1.0, entropy: -0.25, reorder: 4.0}
 se_floor: 2.0
 rollback: promote(previous_stable)
 notify: [#eng-ml, #oncall]
```

infra-bot: Note: rollout locks will be created to avoid double rollbacks. See /runbook/rollouts.

kevin: I'll add the SE check and unit tests. Jess: can you simulate requery amplification in staging?

jess: Yep, will run 3 repeats with synthetic cohort and report.

eval-bot: monitors created for the three signals, alerts -> #eng-ml, pages on rollback.

maya: PR WIP: https://git.internal/repo/rollout-policies/pull/421. If staging sim looks good, we'll enable for int4-v2 tomorrow.

kevin: TL;DR two-of-three auto-fallback, 3x5m persistence, SE noise-floor, p99 special-case.

jess: lgtm, closing after PR lands. :thumbsup:
